description: Curated EKG for deterministic scorer derived from disaster document extraction
provenance: Rules grounded in disaster documents. Initial extraction from config/graph/ekg_tdis.json (Policy + H&H corpora). Added 2026-04-15: 6 coastal/nature-based edges and 4 new concepts (storm_surge, sea_level_rise, land_subsidence, wetland_restoration) from config/graph/ekg_tdis_new.json (WildfireTornado corpus, despite label). Phase A 2026-05-08: added 8 data-grounded concept nodes (expected_annual_loss, buildings, fire_ems, transmission_lines, primary_roads, local_law_enforcement, infrastructure_density, lifeline_access).
